title: Pressing the Enter key on the "Session" button should open its context menu
line: Pressing Enter on a focused button, like the Session button in the Application Launcher, now presses it, just like Space.
explanation: Buttons only react to the keys listed in the platform theme's ButtonPressKeys hint, and KDE's platform theme never set it, so only Qt's default Space worked. Kickoff's Restart and Shut Down buttons handle Return themselves, but the Session menu button doesn't, so Enter did nothing there. The plasma-integration change sets ButtonPressKeys to Space, Return, Enter and Select, as plasma-integration MR !45 does. Kickoff's app items are buttons too, so they would then take Return themselves on key release and skip the view's wait for search results; the plasma-desktop change hands Return and Enter on an item to the view's existing handler, so launching works as before.

commits.message:
KdePlatformTheme: Allow Space/Enter/Return/Select to press buttons

Buttons only reacted to Space when they had keyboard focus, so pressing
Enter on a focused button such as Kickoff's Session menu did nothing.
Set the ButtonPressKeys hint so Enter, Return and Select press it too.

BUG: 519042

applets/kickoff: let the view handle Return and Enter on items

Once the platform theme lets Return and Enter press buttons, a focused
item handled them itself on key release and skipped the view's wait for
search results, losing some launches. Forward both keys to the view.

BUG: 519042

From 56ec073d975f724a5866c787185f4b6e6735d4a7 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 13:50:43 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/kickoff: let the view handle Return and Enter on
 items

Once the platform theme lets Return and Enter press buttons, a focused
item handled them itself on key release and skipped the view's wait for
search results, losing some launches. Forward both keys to the view.

BUG: 519042
---
 applets/kickoff/AbstractKickoffItemDelegate.qml | 4 ++++
 1 file changed, 4 insertions(+)

diff --git a/applets/kickoff/AbstractKickoffItemDelegate.qml b/applets/kickoff/AbstractKickoffItemDelegate.qml
index bc4fcbae6c..a9fa305ce0 100644
--- a/applets/kickoff/AbstractKickoffItemDelegate.qml
+++ b/applets/kickoff/AbstractKickoffItemDelegate.qml
@@ -125,6 +125,10 @@ T.ItemDelegate {
         action.trigger()
     }
 
+    // Leave Return and Enter to the view, which waits for search results when needed
+    Keys.onReturnPressed: event => root.view.Keys.pressed(event)
+    Keys.onEnterPressed: event => root.view.Keys.pressed(event)
+
     // Using an action so that it can be replaced or manually triggered
     // using `model` () instead of `root.model` leads to errors about
     // `model` not having the trigger() function
-- 
2.53.0

Subject: [PATCH] KdePlatformTheme: Allow Space/Enter/Return/Select to press
 buttons

Set the ButtonPressKeys hint so Enter, Return and Select press it too.

BUG: 519042
---
 qt6/src/platformtheme/khintssettings.cpp | 2 ++
 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+)

diff --git a/qt6/src/platformtheme/khintssettings.cpp b/qt6/src/platformtheme/khintssettings.cpp
index 988ebae..fcff470 100644
--- a/qt6/src/platformtheme/khintssettings.cpp
+++ b/qt6/src/platformtheme/khintssettings.cpp
@@ -132,6 +132,8 @@ KHintsSettings::KHintsSettings(const KSharedConfig::Ptr &kdeglobals)
 
     m_hints[QPlatformTheme::ShowShortcutsInContextMenus] = true;

     QMetaObject::invokeMethod(this, "delayedDBusConnects", Qt::QueuedConnection);
     QMetaObject::invokeMethod(this, "setupIconLoader", Qt::QueuedConnection);

media.caption: Before: Kirigami prompt dialog with Cancel focused (left); Enter does nothing (right)
After: same dialog with Cancel focused (left); Enter presses Cancel once and closes it (right)

review.text: Clean, idiomatic fix in plasma-integration using Qt's official QPlatformTheme::ButtonPressKeys hint, matching plasma-integration!45 and the maintainer guidance on the bug report. Before/after screenshots and regression checks confirm that pressing Enter on Kickoff's focused Session button opens its menu while preserving Space and existing Return handlers.

reviews.text: Clean, idiomatic fix in plasma-integration using Qt's official QPlatformTheme::ButtonPressKeys hint, matching plasma-integration!45 and the maintainer guidance on the bug report. Before/after screenshots and regression checks confirm that pressing Enter on Kickoff's focused Session button opens its menu while preserving Space and existing Return handlers.

All earlier requests are resolved. The Kickoff regression I suspected was real: a fast Enter in search results lost the launch in 3 of 5 runs. The new plasma-desktop commit routes Return/Enter from AbstractKickoffItemDelegate to the view's existing Keys.onPressed handler, so launchMatchTimer and the grid activation run on key press again, and every Kickoff path launches exactly once. Kicker's delegates already handle Return themselves. Kirigami PromptDialog, a QML KCM and the Session button were re-checked, and the new before-1/after-1 pair clearly shows no menu on master and the menu opening with the fix. The ButtonPressKeys hint is the plasma-integration !45 approach Nate named in c1. Its Qt Widgets side effect, where Enter on a focused checkbox in a dialog toggles it instead of pressing the default button, is documented in the notes and matches QGnomeTheme. The maintainers should know about it, but it doesn't block this fix.

history.text: Setting QPlatformTheme::ButtonPressKeys in KDE's platform theme is the approach Nate endorsed in c1, and it fixes the reported Session button (after-2 shows the menu opening on Enter). But it changes Return/Enter for every focused Qt Quick AbstractButton in every app, and verify only re-checked Kickoff's Leave buttons, which have their own Keys handlers. Focused AbstractButton-based delegates (e.g. Kickoff's T.ItemDelegate, which ListView focuses via focusCurrentItem) will now accept the Return press themselves, so the parent view's Keys.onPressed Return handling (Kickoff's launchMatchTimer logic, grid view activation) is bypassed and activation moves to key release. Also, before-1 and after-1 are identical shots that prove nothing.
changes: Regression-test the paths where a parent handles Return for a focused button-like child: in Kickoff, arrow into a list and a grid (favourites, apps, search results while the runner is still querying), press Enter and confirm the item launches exactly once and the search timing logic still works; adjust Kickoff if the view's handler is now bypassed in a harmful way

Check a Kirigami/QQC2 dialog with a default (accept) button while another button such as Cancel has focus, and a QML KCM in System Settings, to confirm Enter now does the expected thing and nothing triggers twice
Replace the identical before-1/after-1 pair with media that show the difference (e.g. before: Enter pressed, no menu; after: menu open)

history.summary: Kept the ButtonPressKeys hint and added a plasma-desktop commit: Kickoff's items now hand Return and Enter to the view's existing handler, because with the hint alone a fast Enter in search results was sometimes lost. I re-tested Kickoff, Kirigami/QQC2 dialogs, System Settings and a widgets dialog, and replaced both media pairs.

answers.request: Regression-test the paths where a parent handles Return for a focused button-like child: in Kickoff, arrow into a list and a grid (favourites, apps, search results while the runner is still querying), press Enter and confirm the item launches exactly once and the search timing logic still works; adjust Kickoff if the view's handler is now bypassed in a harmful way
answers.answer: Done, counting launches of a test app that writes to a log. You were right: with the hint alone, the focused delegate took Return and launched on key release, which skipped the view's handler. When I typed, tabbed into the results and pressed Enter right away, the launch was lost in 3 of 5 runs (the pressed delegate was replaced when the results arrived). Master launched 8/8. Fix in plasma-desktop: AbstractKickoffItemDelegate forwards Return and Enter to root.view.Keys.pressed(event), the same trick Klipper and Emojier use, so the view's launchMatchTimer and grid logic run again, on key press as before. With both commits every path launches exactly once: favourites grid, search field, Tab into results, the fast and still-querying keyword paths (8/8 and 4/4), the Utilities list, the category sidebar then the list, Space on a grid item, a Places entry (one Dolphin window) and the context menu (Remove from Favorites, nothing launched).

answers.request: Check a Kirigami/QQC2 dialog with a default (accept) button while another button such as Cancel has focus, and a QML KCM in System Settings, to confirm Enter now does the expected thing and nothing triggers twice
answers.answer: Done. Kirigami.PromptDialog (OK|Cancel) in a test window: on master Enter does nothing on either button. With the fix, Enter presses the focused button once: Cancel logs rejected once, OK logs accepted once. Kirigami dialogs have no default button that Enter would press otherwise. A QQC2 Button and CheckBox fire once per Enter, and a TextField still emits accepted. System Settings, General Behavior KCM: Enter toggles a focused checkbox once (Apply and the title asterisk follow, and a second Enter restores it), opens a contextual help button's tooltip, and the sidebar's own Return handler opens a single page. Enter on Discard in the unsaved-changes prompt discards once. I also checked Qt Widgets, because the hint applies there too: in Dolphin's settings dialog, Enter on a focused checkbox now toggles it, where master pressed the dialog's default OK. That is in the notes for Niccolò.

answers.request: Replace the identical before-1/after-1 pair with media that show the difference (e.g. before: Enter pressed, no menu; after: menu open)
answers.answer: Done. before-1 and after-1 each show two panels: the Session button focused, then the state after Enter (master: no menu and focus gone; fix: the Lock/Log Out/Switch User menu open). before-2 and after-2 show the Kirigami prompt dialog with Cancel focused, before and after Enter (master: still open; fix: closed once).
